free_tier.stated: Base plan EUR 4.99/mo = 1 TB storage + 1 TB egress; 100 buckets, 50M objects/bucket, 100 TB/bucket, 5 TB max object

per_object_cap.stated: 5 TB maximum single object (via multipart upload)

egress.terms: "The base plan includes 1 TB storage and 1 TB egress. Overages are billed at EUR 0.005/GB/month for storage and EUR 1.00/TB for egress. Ingress (uploads) and API calls are always free."

record.tooling: AWS CLI, rclone, Cyberduck, s3cmd, MinIO client, Node/Python(boto3)/Go SDKs. All named.
record.chaining: S3 origin; versioning, object lock/WORM, lifecycle, presigned URLs, SSE-C all supported.
record.limits_note: Single-provider small host; static website hosting explicitly not supported; no per-TB graduated tier. The overage rate is a derived per-GB rate, not a published block price.
